successCriteria.description: The Notification entity's `type` field is typed as `NotificationType` enum (not `string`), matching the already-imported enum at line 2 of notification.model.ts
The Notification entity's `status` field is typed as `NotificationStatus` enum (not `string`), matching the already-imported enum at line 2 of notification.model.ts
`tsc --noEmit` passes with zero type errors — the changed field types must not introduce any new compilation errors in notification.model.ts or any file that imports Notification

constraints: Only the `type` and `status` field types in the `Notification` entity interface change — no other field, interface method signature, import, or export may be modified

The existing imports `import { NotificationType, NotificationStatus } from '../../shared/types'` at line 2 of notification.model.ts must remain unchanged — they are already correct and in use by the repository/service interfaces
outOfScope: Any changes to `INotificationRepository` or `INotificationService` interfaces — they already use the correct enum types
Creating or modifying any test files — no tests exist for the notification module yet (tests come in Phase 6)

entityInvariants.invariant: The `type` field must always be one of the `NotificationType` enum values: `leave_submitted`, `leave_approved`, `leave_rejected`, `leave_cancelled`
The `status` field must always be one of the `NotificationStatus` enum values: `pending`, `sent`, `read`, `archived`

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The Notification entity's `type` field type must match the `NotificationType` enum already used by `INotificationRepository.findByRecipientIdAndStatus` (parameter `status: NotificationStatus`) and `INotificationService` method doc-comments (which reference `NotificationType.leave_submitted`, etc.) in the same file

The Notification entity must follow the same pattern as the sibling LeaveRequest entity, which already uses enum types (`LeaveType`, `LeaveStatus`) for its `leaveType` and `status` fields rather than plain `string`

integrationPoints.why: The `INotificationService` interface in notification.model.ts imports `LeaveRequest` as a type-only import. The LeaveRequest entity already uses enum types correctly, so no change is needed there — but the type-check must verify that the cross-module type dependency remains sound after the Notification entity fields are corrected
